messages:
maria: FYI the image-bakery pipeline started producing OCI layout artifacts this morning and the SBOM step is failing intermittently in CI. eu-west builder nodes reported pulls failing.
aj: seen it, queuing a look. any logs from the node bootstrap?
maria: paste from a failed kubelet: `pull access denied, manifest unknown: manifest for registry.redwood.example.com/bakery/gpu-builder:2026-04-11 not found` then a digest mismatch on the fallback.
devon: sounds like we pushed index vs manifest list changes. CI now emits `application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json` by default. older k8s node pullers in eu-west (GCR mirror) don't follow redirects well.
leo: 👀 also noticed SBOM step uses syft v0.70 which only understands docker manifest by default, so it chokes on OCI index and exits non-zero.
ci-bot: build 2987 failed: sbom-generation step exited 2; triggered retry at 2026-04-11T08:22:10Z.
aj: quick mitigation: can we make the bakery produce both manifest list and a tagged manifest (force docker schema v2)? or add a `--format docker` flag in the pipeline?
maria: we can, but that risks diverging artifact digests. downstream Helm charts pin digests in gitops (we use digests in values-prod.yaml). if we change the output shape the digest will change and rollouts will mismatch.
devon: alternative: update syft to latest and add `--platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64` so it can inspect indexes. that avoids republishing images.
sre-oncall: urgent: several eu-west nodes failed to join CI cluster because image pullbacks caused kubelet timeouts, inflating spot instance churn. cost spike on infra this morning ~ +13% for autoscaler retries.
leo: can we temporarily allow the gitops helmfiles to accept tags instead of digests for the bakery images in the CI pools? that would be faster but less immutable.
aj: not ideal for prod, but for ci we can relax pinning. create a short-lived commit in infra/gitops: `values-ci.yaml` override to use tags for `bakery/gpu-builder:ci-latest`. rollback after fix.
maria: doing that now. also filing a follow-up: we need a canonical contract for bakery outputs (OCI vs docker) and SBOM generation tooling pinned in the pipeline.
devon: long term: enable sigstore/cosign provenance and attestation in the pipeline so anyone can verify which manifest/digest maps to which SBOM. that will handle the multi-artifact problem.
sre-oncall: also check registry replication: eu-west mirror had TTL misconfig and evicted some blobs. replication logs show `blob unknown` for march uploads. might be root cause for missing digests.
leo: I'll open a quick incubator PR to add `replication: async` -> `replication: sync` for the eu-west proxy. need approvals from registry-admins.
aj: ci fix merged: infra/gitops@bb3f7c -> sets bakery image to tag for CI pools. retrying bakery workflow.
ci-bot: build 2990 started: sbom step running (syft 0.73).
maria: syft upgrade fixed SBOM generation, but we still need guidance on whether bakery should emit index+manifests or single arch manifests. I'll assemble a short RFC.
devon: propose default: bakery emits multi-arch index + attach per-platform manifest and uploads separate SBOMs with `artifact:sha256:<digest>` references and cosigned attestations. then gitops continues to pin digest of the manifest we decide to deploy.
sre-oncall: low effort: add health check alert when registry manifest fetches >5% errors over 5m in region. that would've caught eu-west earlier.
leo: noted. PR for registry replication and the alert coming in infra-monitoring.
maria: thanks all — follow-ups: (1) rollback relax pinning in CI after we validate index flow; (2) RFC on artifact contract; (3) add cosign attestation step; (4) replication + alert.
aj: assign tasks in the infra board. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: note: build 2990 succeeded: sbom step OK.
maria: closing thread, opening RFC draft in docs/rfc-bakery-artifact-contract.md and linking to this thread.
